newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes flat at 3,050-3,200 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes flat at 3,050-3,200 per dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed around 3,050-3,200 per dollar, virtually unchanged from the morning's 3,100-3,200, but down from 2,700-2,800 at Thursday's close, dealers said.
"Most clients who were bidding for dollars in the morning left the market in early afternoon and the lev idled in light volumes close to opening levels until the close," one dealer said.
Expectations of a continuing lev decline amid the deepening economic crisis would deter a rise in foreign currency supply next week, traders said.
"The lev could hit 4,000 per dollar next week due to scarce dollar offers at increasingly high exchange rates," another dealer said.
The lev traded at 1,930-2,000 a week ago. It stood near 600 at the beginning of the year.
